theme_archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Light Theme Primary with Deep Dark Tech accents)
vibe_description: Futuristic but simple, premium tech brand (Apple Vision Pro, Rivian, Polestar). Readable, high-contrast, structural, tactile, and highly performant.

type_scale.overline: font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

tokens.spacing: Generous paddings (py-24, py-32 for sections), tight gaps for data (gap-2).
tokens.radii: sm (4px) or rounded-none for structural grids. full (9999px) for primary action pills.
tokens.borders: Hairline (1px) everywhere. Replace standard full borders with CSS grid border-collapse techniques where possible to mimic technical blueprints.

atmospheric_effects.grain_overlay: Add a fixed pointer-events-none full-screen div with a subtle SVG noise filter (opacity-[0.03] in light mode, opacity-[0.05] in dark mode) and z-index 50 (below interactive modals but above content).
atmospheric_effects.data_grid_bg: Use a subtle repeating linear-gradient background on specific sections (Tech Stack) to look like engineering graph paper: bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#e5e5e5_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#e5e5e5_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:32px_32px]. Use mask-image to fade edges.
atmospheric_effects.live_activity_ribbon: A 28px tall, font-mono text-[10px] ticker at the very top of the viewport (above header). bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-400. Content: 'SYSTEM ONLINE • 312 DEALERS CONNECTED • LATEST ORDER: 2 MINS AGO'.
atmospheric_effects.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky elements (Header). Add a hairline inner shadow or bottom border (border-b border-zinc-200/50) to simulate milled crystal.
atmospheric_effects.color_temperature_shift: Apply subtle background tinting based on scroll depth: warm hero (bg-stone-50) -> cool tech section (bg-zinc-50) -> neutral footer (bg-white).

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-zinc-200/50
header.adjustments: Do NOT redesign the navigation structure. Update colors from slate to zinc. Add a magnetic micro-interaction to the 'Sign in' button.

hero.classes: relative w-full h-[280px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[500px] lg:h-[560px]
hero.adjustments: Keep existing image. Add a subtle gradient mesh overlay at the very bottom (bg-gradient-to-t from-white via-white/50 to-transparent h-32 absolute bottom-0 w-full) to blend the image seamlessly. Add an expanding custom cursor ('VIEW') when hovering.

headline_section.classes: max-w-5xl mx-auto px-5 sm:px-6 pt-12 sm:pt-16 pb-10 sm:pb-12
headline_section.adjustments: Implement stagger fade-up (Framer Motion). Button cluster CTAs should feature magnetic hover. Make the subhead text-zinc-500.

five_pillars.adjustments: Replace boxed cards with a Bento/Swiss grid using visible hairline borders (border-collapse style). Numbering (01, 02) must be monospaced and prominent.

joy_beast_atelier.adjustments: Apply custom cursor on the BYD Sealion image. Service pillars should use 1px sleek SVG paths instead of solid icons. The kit tier strip should use pure monospaced labels.

experience_centre.classes: bg-[#09090B] text-zinc-300 py-14 sm:py-20 relative overflow-hidden
experience_centre.adjustments: Dark mode section. Add a very subtle aurora/gradient mesh blob in the background (deep navy/red, highly blurred). Architectural renders should be in a tight bento grid (gap-2) with no border-radius. Labels should be glassmorphic floating pills (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40).

tech_stack.classes: bg-white py-14 sm:py-20 border-y border-zinc-200 relative
tech_stack.adjustments: Apply the data_grid_bg class here. The 3 cards should have solid white backgrounds with sharp 1px borders. Add 'number-counter' animations for metrics.

personas_and_capabilities.adjustments: Convert to a technical spec sheet layout. Remove full card borders and use horizontal hairline rules (border-y only) to separate items for a Dieter Rams, open aesthetic.

how_it_works.adjustments: Make the numbered steps look like a technical timeline. font-mono numbers with hairline connecting lines.

live_order_showcase.adjustments: Redesign the progress bar to be an ultra-thin (h-[2px]) crisp line. The WhatsApp fallback should look like a dark terminal window (bg-zinc-950, green mono text).

footer.adjustments: Minimalist grid. Keep the copyright and tagline aligned on a single bottom hairline row.

micro_interactions.buttons: Use Framer Motion or CSS for magnetic feel: active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
micro_interactions.links: hover:text-zinc-900 transition-colors duration-200. No heavy underlines.
micro_interactions.scroll_fade: Wrap major section headers and grids in Framer Motion `<motion.div>` with `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` `whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}` `viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-50px' }}` `transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}`.
micro_interactions.number_counters: Use Framer Motion's `animate` function on a React `useEffect` to tick numbers up from 0 when the component is in view (e.g., the 38+ parts capability).
micro_interactions.custom_cursor: A framer-motion div that follows the mouse when hovering over the Hero and BYD images. 80px circle, backdrop-blur-md, bg-white/20, text-white text-[10px] tracking-widest center aligned.

mobile_considerations.typography: Scale down h1 to text-4xl sm:text-5xl on mobile to prevent wrapping issues with long words.
mobile_considerations.layout: Grid borders on the 'Five Pillars' should stack cleanly with a bottom border for each item, removing right/left borders to prevent double-thickness.
mobile_considerations.images: Keep mobile images capped at max-h-[60vh] so they don't dominate the entire screen.
mobile_considerations.interactions: Disable custom cursors and heavy magnetic effects on mobile (use `(hover: hover)` media queries). Ensure touch targets for glassmorphic pills are at least 44x44px.

component_updates.instruction: Update the prerender shell to include the top live activity ribbon and the subtle grain overlay div to ensure the fallback matches the new vibe perfectly while React loads.

Replace slate-* with zinc-* everywhere. Implement Framer Motion stagger fade-ups. Add custom cursor state. Re-structure grid classes to use hairline borders. Add the top activity ticker. Preserve all data-testid attributes.
Add CSS variables for the grain effect, custom cursor hiding on mobile, and standard global text selection matching the primary color.
Add JetBrains Mono to the font family theme configuration.
